title: Only the changes
summary: An elementary cellular automaton played as music, where a cell sounds only on the beat it is born. Pick any of the 256 rules and hear only what changes.

title: Collatz coral
summary: Every number from 2 to 10,000 traced back to 1 under the Collatz rule, grown as a tree that bends one way after even steps and the other after odd ones.

title: The Attraction Table
summary: A pocket universe of 900 dots in six colours and one table of likes and dislikes. Tap the table to change the rules and watch cells, chasers and rings form.
